description: GlaxoSmithKline Pakistan Limited is the Pakistan operating company of GSK, a global biopharma company, and has been providing medicines and vaccines in the country for over seven decades; its legacy company, Glaxo Laboratories Pakistan Ltd., was the first pharmaceutical company listed on the Karachi Stock Exchange, in 1951. It manufactures through three Global Supply Chain facilities in Karachi — at F-268 SITE, West Wharf and Korangi — which together produce over 430 million packs a year, and its therapy areas include anti-infectives, dermatology, analgesics and vaccines.
headOffice: 35, Dockyard Road, West Wharf, Karachi 74000, Pakistan
